en: Vintage sepia postcard view over a small European town in a valley, surrounded by rolling hills and farmland. In the center stands a prominent church with a tall spire, and clustered around it are traditional houses and farm buildings. At the top in red Gothic-style lettering is the title 'Neuhausen i. Sa.'. Along the left margin in red, smaller vertical print appears to be the publisher information and a number.
